company.description: BerryLab is a Dubai-based Web3 assistant and crypto wallet management platform designed to help users monitor blockchain wallets, track digital assets, receive alerts, and manage on-chain activity across multiple networks. The platform primarily operates through a mobile application focused on productivity, security, and blockchain analytics.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $3,000, or 16.67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $18,000, representing 100% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 35 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-10).
